events.title: Cathy Ames burns her parents' house and vanishes
events.summary: Young Cathy steals her father's money and sets fire to the family house, killing both parents. She makes it look as if she died too, and leaves to start a new life.
events.rationale: This shows Cathy's ruthless nature and starts her life apart from any family. That life leads to the hidden identity Cal later exposes.

events.title: Mr. Edwards nearly beats Cathy to death
events.summary: Cathy becomes the mistress of the whoremaster Mr. Edwards and manipulates him. When he sees her for what she is, he beats her savagely and leaves her for dead.
events.rationale: The beating leaves Cathy helpless near the Trask farm, which is how she enters Adam's life.

events.title: The battered Cathy reaches the Trask farm
events.summary: Cathy crawls to the Trask brothers' farmhouse. Adam takes her in, while Charles distrusts her from the start.
events.rationale: Without this meeting, Cathy would never become Adam's wife and the twins' mother.

events.title: Adam marries Cathy and plans to go to California
events.summary: Adam nurses Cathy back to health, falls in love with her and marries her. He plans to take her west to California.
events.rationale: The marriage makes Cathy the mother of Adam's sons and brings her to the Salinas Valley.

events.title: On the wedding night Cathy drugs Adam and goes to Charles
events.summary: Cathy secretly gives Adam the sleeping medicine meant for her. She then goes to Charles's bed, which leaves the twins' parentage uncertain.
events.rationale: This betrayal is the secret Kate later uses to taunt Adam. It is part of the shameful truth about their mother that Cal forces on Aron.

events.title: Samuel delivers Cathy's twins
events.summary: Lee fetches Samuel Hamilton, who acts as midwife when Cathy gives birth to twin boys. In her rage Cathy bites Samuel's hand.
events.rationale: Cal and Aron are born here, and the focal scene happens between these two sons.

events.title: Cathy shoots Adam and abandons her family
events.summary: Soon after the birth, Cathy announces that she is leaving. When Adam blocks her, she shoots him in the shoulder and walks out on him and the infants.
events.rationale: The boys grow up without their mother, and her disappearance becomes the family secret Cal later exposes.

events.title: Cathy becomes 'Kate' at Faye's brothel in Salinas
events.summary: Cathy takes the name Kate and goes to work at Faye's house in Salinas. She quickly wins the motherly madam's affection.
events.rationale: This gives her the new identity and the Salinas location where her sons will one day find her.

events.title: Faye dies and Kate takes over the brothel
events.summary: Kate gets Faye to name her as heir and then slowly poisons her. After Faye's death Kate owns the house and runs it as a notorious brothel.
events.rationale: Kate's house is the very place Cal later takes Aron to show him their mother.

events.title: Samuel shakes Adam awake and the twins are named
events.summary: Samuel finds Adam still numb from Cathy's desertion and strikes him to rouse him. Samuel, Adam and Lee read the Cain and Abel story and name the boys Caleb and Aron.
events.rationale: The naming sets up the Cain-and-Abel rivalry between the brothers, which climaxes in Cal's attack on Aron.

events.title: Samuel tells Adam where Cathy is
events.summary: On his farewell visit, after the talk about timshel, Samuel tells Adam that Cathy is Kate and runs a Salinas brothel. He hopes the truth will free Adam.
events.rationale: Adam learns Kate's identity and is pushed to face her, which breaks his long paralysis.

events.title: Adam confronts Kate after Samuel's funeral
events.summary: After Samuel's funeral Adam goes to Kate's brothel. She mocks him and hints that Charles fathered the twins, but Adam leaves free of her.
events.rationale: Freed of his obsession, Adam returns to life and to his sons, while still keeping their mother a secret from them.

events.title: The Trasks move to Salinas
events.summary: Adam moves the household into the town of Salinas, where the boys go to school. Aron grows close to Abra, while Cal roams the town.
events.rationale: Living in Salinas puts the twins in the same town as Kate's brothel, which makes both Cal's discovery and the final visit possible.

events.title: Adam's refrigerated lettuce venture fails
events.summary: Adam invests heavily in shipping iced lettuce east by rail. The shipment is delayed and rots, and he loses much of his fortune.
events.rationale: Cal later tries to win his father's love by replacing the lost money.

events.title: Cal discovers his mother is alive and runs a brothel
events.summary: Wandering at night, Cal learns through Rabbit Holman that the madam Kate is his mother. Lee then tells him the truth about Cathy and urges him not to blame himself for her.
events.rationale: Cal now holds the secret that he will later use against Aron.

events.title: Cal visits Kate and rejects her
events.summary: Cal follows Kate and confronts her in her room. She sees herself in him, but he declares he does not have to be like her.
events.citation: I don't have to be you
events.rationale: Cal learns the way to Kate's house and gains a bond with her that he can draw on later.

events.title: Cal partners with Will Hamilton to speculate in beans
events.summary: Hoping to replace his father's lost money, Cal asks Will Hamilton for help. Will advises buying up beans before wartime prices rise.
events.rationale: This venture produces the money Cal offers Adam as a gift.

events.title: Cal borrows five thousand dollars from Kate
events.summary: To fund his share of the bean deal, Cal goes back to Kate and asks to borrow money. She lends him five thousand dollars.
events.rationale: Kate's money funds Cal's gift, so her thread feeds directly into the rejection that drives Cal to expose her.

events.title: Adam rejects Cal's gift of money
events.summary: At Thanksgiving Cal gives Adam the money he earned from beans. Adam refuses it as war profit and praises Aron instead, crushing Cal.
events.rationale: This rejection, a Cain-like spurning of his offering, provokes Cal's jealous revenge on his brother.

events.title: Cal takes Aron to Kate's house and reveals their mother
events.summary: Hurt and jealous, Cal leads Aron to Kate's brothel. He forces his innocent brother to face Kate and learn that she is their mother, Cathy.
events.citation: I want to show you something
events.rationale: This is the focal event, where the Trask and Cathy/Kate threads converge.
